integrity: The analytic proof establishes the infinite theorem. Exact finite checks are diagnostic only; no independent audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for one identity sheet plus one connected double sheet of a finite-graph covering, with uniform fiber masses; it does not classify general disconnected coverings or nonuniform Markov kernels.

The topological atom-transport and connected-degree-two approximation inputs are proved in Duru--Ilter--Bilgin, arXiv:2610.35575v1; only their application and the new split-cover formulas are claimed.
The two- and three-map specializations are covered by earlier published findings; the budget extension relative to them starts at m>=4 and includes the sharp asymptotic contrast.
Kim (1972), Theorems 3–4, concerns sequential approximation under different hypotheses, not this fixed-budget covering problem; bibliographic priority remains provisional.
title: Fixed-sheet versus double-sheet Markov approximation: exact weighted and equal-weight laws
